bullets.desc: German cockroaches nesting in 6 kitchen cabinets, behind the fridge and under the dishwasher.
Gel bait in cabinet hinges and cracks, an insect growth regulator, and plumbing gaps under the sink sealed.
No live roaches at the 30-day follow-up, and the sticky monitors stayed clean.
